data.title: AGM – Digital Marketing (Performance Marketing & Marketing Technology)
data.jd: &lt;p&gt;&lt;b&gt;Job Description: &lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Senior Manager / AGM – Performance Marketing &amp; Marketing Technology&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;(Designation offered will depend on Candidate&#039;s skills &amp; experience) &lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;b&gt;Role Overview:&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The ideal candidate will lead performance marketing across projects. This role will be responsible for driving business growth through performance marketing and lead nurturing initiatives;  planning and executing multi-channel digital campaigns; optimizing marketing spend based on insights and leading tech-enabled initiatives to enhance customer engagement.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;b&gt;Key Responsibilities:&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;ul&gt;&lt;li&gt;Plan and execute multi-channel campaigns (Email, Facebook/Google, Affiliate Ads, Display, Web, etc.) to achieve short- and long-term business goals, measuring performance against ROI and KPIs.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;Collaborate with business teams to build city- and category-level plans, manage digital marketing infrastructure (Tag Management, Campaign Tracking, Analytics, Attribution, Salesforce, Marketing Automation tools), and optimize spend and performance via experiments and conversion tests.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;Work closely with Presales teams to driver desired results. &lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;Improve lead, walkin and booking performance through continuous optimization &lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;Manage agency partners and media budgets &lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;Lead experimentation using A/B testing and conversion optimization &lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt; Build audience segmentation and remarketing strategies &lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;Collaborate with CRM and Presales teams to improve Lead-to-Visit and Visit-to-Booking conversions&lt;/li&gt;&lt;/ul&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;b&gt;Marketing Technology:&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;● Evaluate and implement new AI /MarTech platforms&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;● Drive automation across marketing workflows&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;● Improve lead routing, attribution and campaign measurement&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;● Integrate CRM, CDP and marketing platforms for seamless data flow&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;● Partner with IT on platform integrations and API-based marketing solutions&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;● Identify opportunities to eliminate manual processes through technology&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;b&gt;AI &amp; Innovation:&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;● Drive adoption of Generative AI across marketing functions&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;● Build AI-powered workflows for : Campaign optimizations, Creative analysis, Competitor intelligence, Reporting automation, Customer journey optimization and Predictive lead scoring&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;● Evaluate emerging AI tools and recommend pilots&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;● Work with IT teams or vendors to implement AI solutions&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;● Build internal AI agents for various departments &amp; scale them. Responsible for governance &amp; compliance.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;b&gt;Website &amp;Conversion Optimization:&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;● Improve website conversion rates&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;● Optimize landing pages&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;● Drive SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;● Implement personalization strategies&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;b&gt;Preferred Experience&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;10+ years in Performance Marketing or Growth Marketing&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Experience in real estate, BFSI, automotive or other high-consideration categories&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Proven experience managing annual digital budgets&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Demonstrated implementation of AI or automation initiatives&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Experience working with cross-functional technology teams&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;b&gt;Location: Mumbai&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

data.title: Branch Ops - Branch Function - APC - Assistant Manager - L1 - Nasik 2 - KA
data.jd:
Job Description :


1. New Business proposal form processing.


2. Primary underwriting.


3. Customer Service.


4. Renewal Calling


5. Stale Cheque Closure.


6. Surrender Retention Retention of customers who come to branch for surrender of policy, by means of 


educating about benefits of long term stay and use of retention kit.


7. ECS Sourcing Convincing and registering customers for ECS by means of educating customers about


benefits from walk-in customers, renewal calling and at all touch points with customers and achieving 


assigned monthly targets.


8. Driving conversion of new business by means of follow-up with sales team on requirements.


9. Driving End to End TAT.


10. Medical Co-ordination in medical proposal forms with medical center, sales team and customer.


11. Riders sourcing from walk-in customers and renewal calling.


12. Follow-up with customers for arranging Direct Credit documents towards all types of pay-outs [ like 


surrender ( part or full), maturity, survival benefit etc. ]


13. Other back office work.


14. Receipting of Premiums new business , renewals, agency, shortfall premiums etc. all types of 


payments in cash and cheque at branches.


15. Banking of cheque and cash collected on previous day thru Bank appointed pick-up person.


16. S2S Service to Sales and cross sell

data.title: Manager/ Sr. Manager - Sales (Belicia, Thane)
data.jd: <p>Channel Partner Sourcing – Manager / Sr. Manager</p><p>Key Responsibilities</p><p>• Build, expand, and activate a strong channel partner (broker) network</p><p>• Drive consistent walk-ins and lead generation through the CP ecosystem</p><p>• Identify and onboard new channel partners across target micro-markets</p><p>• Conduct regular CP meetings, trainings, and engagement initiatives</p><p>• Track CP productivity – walk-ins, conversions, and revenue contribution</p><p><br /></p><p>• Ensure a steady and quality pipeline for the closing team</p><p>Must-Have Criteria</p><p>• 7–10 years of experience in CP sourcing / broker network development</p><p>• Strong broker network and on-ground market presence</p><p>• Proven walk-in generation and pipeline creation capability</p><p>• Experience in scaling CP networks and team handling (for Sr. Manager level)</p><p>• Strong micro-market understanding</p>
